note_tweet.text:
Muse Wonder Full Max might actually be the best AI model in the world right now!

I'm running it through Muse CLI with the $50 Muse Code Power Usage plan, and I'm genuinely impressed. It's incredibly fast, performs really well, and the usage limits are surprisingly generous. So far, it's doing an amazing job!

I'm currently testing it head to head against Opus 5.5 Max and GPT-6 Astra Ultra, and I actually think Muse Wonder is doing a much better job

I'll be sharing the full results soon, including total costs, completion times, and overall performance

Huge credit to Meta for making such a powerful, affordable, and fast model accessible to so many people around the world, Amazing work!
